summary: postinstall fetches and executes native binary from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The postinstall lifecycle script in @onescience/onecode downloads a platform tgz from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz using https.get with `rejectUnauthorized: false` (TLS certificate validation disabled), extracts the archive, chmods the contained binary to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode where it becomes the package's executable. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IPv4 address on a non-standard port rather than a publisher-controlled domain matching the @onescience scope, and disabling TLS validation defeats certificate-based authentication of the origin. Any on-path attacker, DNS/IP takeover, or change of control of that IP can substitute the executed binary, and the installer will run whatever bytes are returned at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
